sign: Town of the gravers. The hall is open to guild folk.

lines: Spring Keeper Oda: The water comes up warm under the basalt. It eases tired Spirlings.
Trader Bastian: Engraved tins, strong brews. Ashmere prices, Ashmere quality.
trader.action: shop strong_tonic max_tonic remedy cooling_gel wake_bell revival_leaf dash_brew guard_brew

lines: Ash-Sweeper Agna: The ash settles by evening. Then we sit by the spring and pretend it never falls.
Kiln-Watcher Dorn: My shift ends when the kilns glow orange. The spring is the only cool place in town.
Glass-Blower Lio: Every evening someone brings a new shard from the plain. We guess what it was before.
